title: Icon Pack Builder project
description: A Singulink Icon Pack Builder project (.ipproj): the icons and variants to export from an icon font source.

Name.description: Project name in Namespace.Class form. It becomes the namespace and class name of the generated C# icon class, and names the export folder and font file.

IconsSourceId.description: Identifier of the icon source the project was built with.

IconsSourceVersion.description: Version of the icon source the project was last saved with. Used to warn when opening the project with an older source.

ExportFormats.description: Outputs written by an export alongside the subset font. Omit to write every format.

GroupId.description: Identifier of the icon in the source (for example 'Save' or 'ArrowPrevious').

ExportName.description: Name of the generated member. Empty to use the icon identifier.

Variants.description: Variants to export. The source's first variant (Regular) is exported under the plain name; others get the variant name appended (for example SaveFilled).
